    if not data:
        return
    W = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])

    B = [0] * 101
    value = M
    base = W

    for i in range(100):
        quotient, remainder = divmod(value, base)
        B[i] = remainder
        value = quotient

    for i in range(100):
        if B[i] > 1:
            B[i] -= base
            B[i + 1] += 1

    for i in range(101):
        if B[i] < -1 or B[i] > 1:
            print("NO")
            return
    print("YES")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
